hub.title: WeChat
hub.intro: Connect a WeChat Official Account (certified Service Account). Inbound lands in your shared Team Inbox and replies, keyword rules and auto-responders work exactly like every other channel.
hub.loadError: Could not load your WeChat channels.
hub.unavailableCountry: WeChat is not available in your country. You cannot connect a channel or send WeChat messages from this workspace.
hub.connectBody: Paste the AppID, AppSecret and the server Token from the WeChat Official Accounts Platform (Settings → Basic Configuration).

steps.account: You need a certified WeChat Official Account (Service Account).
steps.credentials: Open the WeChat Official Accounts Platform → Settings → Basic Configuration → copy the AppID and AppSecret.
steps.serverConfig: Set a Server Config: choose a Token (any string) and mode (Compatible), and — for Safe mode — an EncodingAESKey.
steps.paste: Paste AppID, AppSecret and the Token here and Connect.
steps.back: Copy the webhook URL + Token shown for your channel back into the OA’s Server Config and Enable it.

hub.guideNote: The webhook must be public HTTPS. You may also need to whitelist the server IP in the OA’s IP allowlist. All secrets are encrypted at rest.

good.certified: A certified Service Account is required — Subscription / unverified accounts cannot use these APIs.
good.credentials: Get the AppID + AppSecret from the WeChat Official Accounts Platform (Settings → Basic Configuration).
good.webhook: Paste the webhook URL + Token shown per channel into the OA’s Server Config to activate it.
good.window: Free-form replies work within 48 hours of the user’s last message; outside that a Template Message is required.

connect.title: Connect WeChat
connect.intro: Paste the AppID, AppSecret and the server Token from the WeChat Official Accounts Platform (Settings → Basic Configuration).
connect.verifyTokenPlaceholder: the Token you set in Server Config
connect.failed: Could not connect the channel. Try again.
connect.connected: WeChat connected — now paste the webhook URL + Token below into your WeChat Official Account → Settings → Server Config, and enable it.

channel.failed: That did not work. Try again.

broadcasts.title: WeChat
broadcasts.intro: Mass-send a message to all followers, a tag, or picked users. Note: WeChat limits Service Accounts to about 4 mass sends per month.
broadcasts.sendConfirm: Send this broadcast now? WeChat counts it against your ~4/month limit.
broadcasts.failed: That did not work. Try again.
broadcasts.started: Sending started. WeChat counts it against your monthly mass-send limit.
